title: Eastern Bontok language - Wikipedia
text: Eastern Bontok (Eastern Bontoc) is a language of the Bontok group spoken in the Philippines. The 2007 census claimed there were around 6,200 speakers.

title: Bontok, Southern | Ethnologue Free
text: Southern Bontok is a stable indigenous language of the Philippines. It belongs to the Austronesian language family and is part of the Bontok macrolanguage. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.
